text:
morgan: FYI customer replay hit a nasty edgecase — large mixed-dim batch (100 vectors, dims: [768 x 64 x 512]) -> splitter produced 4 fragments, router sent two fragments to slow shard and two to fast shard, end result: 413s and partial billing mismatch.
li: ugh. do we have traces? which stage billed the tokens wrong?
sam: attaching trace id 178a2f. looks like preflight estimated units=4200 but runtime billed ~5600. mismatch happened when the fast shard fallback retried + merged results.
anya: can you paste the preflight payload? curious what heuristic returned.
morgan: curl example: `curl -X POST /v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input": [...], "model":"rwd-embed-sparse"}'` preflight response included `X-Embed-Estimate: 4200` and `X-Embed-SplitPlan: [40,30,30]`
neal: the splitter_v1 produces the plan based purely on bytes, not slot-aware. when router saw slow shard it retried fragments individually which disables some batching efficiencies — runtime ended up doing per-fragment overheads we didn't account for.
li: that explains the billing delta. two questions: 1) should preflight be conservative (add retry/cost buffer)? 2) console should surface split count and post-request billed_units for customer-facing debugging.
sam: proposal: preflight -> return both `estimate_nominal` and `estimate_with_retries` (nominal = current, retries = +20% by default). also emit telemetry tag `split_count` and `final_billed_units` to make dashboards reconcile.
anya: +1. UX: in Console under request inspector show both estimates and highlight when final_billed > estimate_with_retries (red). add link to troubleshooting doc.
morgan: runtime side: need router change — avoid splitting across heterogeneous shard classes for same request unless forced by capacity. affinity flag: prefer single-class routing, else fallback plan. Could reduce cross-shard retries.
neal: that's doable but will need a canary. I suggest feature flag `embed.splitter_affinity_v2` scoped to 5% tenants. We'll need to add unit tests for fairness when one shard is throttled.
li: telemetry additions: histogram `embed_split_count` (buckets 1,2,3,4,5,10,20), counter `embed_affinity_fallbacks`, and gauge `preflight_estimate_gap` (billed - estimate_with_retries). We should also tag traces with `split_plan` and `routing_path` for postmortem.
sam: rollout plan: implement preflight header change + console surface (backend only) -> deploy canary (3% traffic) -> collect metrics for 48h -> enable affinity flag for 5% -> monitor `embed_retries` and latency p95.
anya: one more customer concern: some SDKs rely on stable unit cost predictions. If we change header semantics, docs + SDK should expose `estimate_with_retries` and a guidance note: "If you rely on tight billing forecasts, use smaller fixed batch sizes or pin model/route."
morgan: agreed. I'll write the doc and a short support playbook.
neal: I'll open PR for router affinity + telemetry. assigning to me, cc @deploy-bot for canary pipeline once merged.
deploy-bot: canary pipeline scheduled: embed-splitter-affinity-v2 -> canary 3% on us-west -> notify #eng-oncall on failure.
li: ok thanks. action items: morgan doc + support playbook, neal PR for router + telemetry, sam change preflight header, anya console UI card for inspector. we'll sync in triage tomorrow. :thumbsup:
